title: Tashkent Rising
author: E. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Edmund Sandoval, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
